justification: `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/Gson.java` is a 1547-line class with 47 public methods. It combines several separable responsibilities in one unit: configuration copying (`newBuilder`, constructor setup), adapter registry/lookup (`getAdapter`, `getDelegateAdapter`), JSON tree/string/stream serialization (`toJson*`, `newJsonWriter`), deserialization (`fromJson*`, `newJsonReader`), and cyclic-adapter plumbing (`FutureTypeAdapter`), which is strong evidence of insufficient modularization.
